company.name: FanTV AI
company.shortDescription: FanTV enables creators to produce and monetize digital media using AI agents within a Web3 ecosystem.
company.description: FanTV enables creators to produce and monetize digital media using AI agents within a Web3 ecosystem. The platform supports the creation of videos, music, podcasts, web series, and vlogs via simple prompts, and allows creators to earn through engagement, creator tokens, and decentralized monetization mechanisms. Built on blockchain technology—originally on Polygon and now deployed on the Sui network—it supports over 8 million on-chain wallets, 80,000 creators, and has processed more than 30 million content transactions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $3,000,000, or 35.29% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $30,706,723 to $38,192,004, a 1.24x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 94 (+31 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
